S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

symptom.disease_info: Persistent Depressive Disorder is a chronic depressive condition defined by a persistently depressed mood lasting at least two years in adults, accompanied by associated changes such as appetite or weight disturbance, sleep disturbance, low energy, and functional impairment. Its course is typically steady and long-running rather than episodic, which distinguishes it from a single time-limited major depressive episode, though symptoms can still become clinically significant and impairing.

patient.stressor_event: Major change in the health or behavior of a family member
patient.stressor: Two years and four months ago, Lan’s mother-in-law developed worsening health problems and moved into Lan and her husband’s home, turning Lan’s professional caregiving skills into an around-the-clock family responsibility after her paid home-health shifts ended. At first Lan treated the change as a duty consistent with her family values, but over time her museum visits, hiking, calligraphy, and volunteer art workshops were steadily crowded out while her mood remained low, her eating and sleep patterns changed, and fatigue followed her through both work and home. The condition became clinically significant when she began cutting back on mentoring newer aides and made uncharacteristic documentation delays, while her husband noticed that even weekly family meals no longer restored her. She entered psychiatric care after a primary-care visit for persistent exhaustion led to a referral, and the timeline clarified a continuous 2-year-and-4-month depressive course with functional impairment.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: Most days I feel like the color has gone out of things, even when I'm sitting at Sunday dinner with my family or looking at art I used to enjoy, and I have to work hard not to tear up for no clear reason.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.
S026.manifestation: I don't have much appetite anymore, so I end up picking at whatever I make for everyone else or grabbing toast after my shift, and my clothes have been hanging looser without me trying.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: I'm here because for a long time now my sleep has been broken—I fall into bed exhausted, wake up to every little sound in the house, and then I'm up before the alarm feeling like I never really rested.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: By the time I finish seeing my home-health clients and come back to help at home, my body feels heavy and even charting notes or folding laundry can feel like too much to push through.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: I've started falling behind on my client documentation and I don't volunteer to mentor newer aides the way I used to, because just keeping up with the basics at work and at home takes everything I have.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on since my mother-in-law moved in with us a little over two years ago.
